Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Givhan
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 03/01/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 249 as introduced could increase or decrease receipts to the State General Fund and municipal general funds from fines; increase receipts to the State General Fund, county general funds, municipal general funds, and other funds to which court costs are deposited; and could increase the obligations of the State General Fund, local jails, the district attorneys, the Department of Corrections, and the Bureau of Pardons and Paroles by an undetermined amount dependent upon the number of persons charged with and convicted of the offenses provided by this bill and the penalties imposed.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs
